messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning a staged publish for Python + TS SDKs during tomorrow's publish window (2026-03-21 09:00–11:00 PST). Target versions: py 2.2.0, ts 2.2.0. Intend to deprecate legacy sync client (1.x) with a 90-day notice.
morgan: SGTM. Any breaking changes? release notes? :eyes:
alex: Minimal API change — rename `Client.sync()` -> `Client.legacy_sync()` (deprecated alias kept for 90 days). Main changes are perf and typed events, plus a small telemetry opt-in.
sam: Can we add a short migration snippet for README? I'll prepare.
tasha: Requesting we pin the canary to internal + beta partners first. Plan: 10% traffic for 24h, then 50% if metrics OK. Also we should publish deprecation notice in the SDK changelog.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled publish job queued: job_id=pub-198765-sdks
ci-bot: [ci-bot] artifacts uploaded: redwood-py-2.2.0.whl, redwood-js-2.2.0.tgz
alex: Rollback criteria: >1.5% error increase OR +200ms p50 latency OR any critical auth regression. If triggered, rollback to 2.1.4 and cut hotfix.
morgan: For customers: I have an email draft and migration guide; will paste link here when ready. :+1:
sam: Migration snippet (to include in release notes):
```
# python
from redwood import Client
# old
client.sync(data)
# new
client.legacy_sync(data)  # alias, will log deprecation
```
tasha: Also adding package pin docs for platform teams:
- Python: `pip install redwood-sdk==2.1.4` to stay on legacy
- NPM: `npm install @redwood/sdk@^2.1.4`

tasha: also add npm/py pin guidance to release blog and support KB.
alex: If we need an immediate rollback later, use `deploy-bot rollback pub-198765-sdks --to-tag v2.1.4` and notify #oncall.
